verdict.rationale: Steel is an API-first cloud browser service built for programmatic automation. Its Sessions API spins up isolated browsers on demand, the official CLI runs full browser workflows end-to-end from the terminal, and a published OpenAPI spec plus a pre-built Docker image support self-hosted, scripted runs. Missing for 10: explicit CI pipeline documentation (e.g., GitHub Actions examples or non-interactive auth setup), and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
